channel.title: Jacksonville Daily Record - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Jacksonville Daily Record (jaxdailyrecord.com)

item.title: UF Health Intracoastal center nears $20 million investment
item.description: The city issued a permit Nov. 26 for construction of the ER, urgent care center and medical offices along Atlantic Boulevard.

item.title: Jacksonville Transportation Authority purchases property in Gateway Town Center
item.description: In January, the JTA board approved negotiations to buy a 7,900-square-foot building in the mall for a workforce training site.

item.title: Brooks Rehabilitation plans $68 million in Northeast Florida expansions
item.description: Projects at facilities in Duval and Clay counties will add 150 jobs.

item.title: HCA Florida Healthcare opens emergency room in Oakleaf Plantation
item.description: The addition at Oakleaf Plantation Parkway and First Coast Expressway will serve patients in Clay and Duval counties.

item.title: Caitlin Brunell named vice president of Ascension St. Vincent’s Foundation
item.description: The nonprofit leader joins the organization after serving as executive director of the American Heart Association in Jacksonville.

item.title: New emergency health facility opens in Arlington
item.description: HCA Florida Memorial Hospital launched the 24/7 emergency room Jan. 7.

item.title: Baptist Health planning nearly $110 million hotel on Downtown Southbank
item.description: The 226-room hotel would be built on what is now a parking lot at Palm Avenue and Gary Street.

item.title: Baptist Center for Professional Excellence provides advanced simulated training for hospital staff
item.description: Features include fully equipped operating rooms, patient rooms and mannequins that exhibit medical conditions.

item.title: AdventHealth planning World Commerce emergency department
item.description: The 12-room facility is the first phase of a medical campus off International Golf Parkway.

item.title: Deadline is Jan. 30: Are you one of Northeast Florida’s top entrepreneurs? We want to know about it
item.description: If you built a business that’s at least 3 years old, now’s the chance to share your story with the Daily Record audience.
